events.title: Vibe 25: Blue Moon Saloon 25th Anniversary, Day One
events.blurb: Night one of the Blue Moon's silver-anniversary party, with Troy Richard of the Richard Revue, SideQuest featuring Gino V. and Zach Edwards, and Roddie Romero and the Hub City Allstars. Doors open at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Primera noche de la fiesta de aniversario de plata del Blue Moon, con Troy Richard de the Richard Revue, SideQuest featuring Gino V. and Zach Edwards, y Roddie Romero and the Hub City Allstars. Las puertas abren a las 6 p.m.

events.title: Vibe 25: Blue Moon Saloon 25th Anniversary, Day Two
events.blurb: Day two of the anniversary brings a cookoff and Cajun music from 3 p.m., with the Elise Riley Band, the Slackers, Grand Nathaniel, Brass Bed and Knives in the Champion.
events.blurbEs: El segundo día del aniversario trae un concurso de cocina y música cajún desde las 3 p.m., con the Elise Riley Band, the Slackers, Grand Nathaniel, Brass Bed y Knives in the Champion.

events.title: Savoy Family Cajun Band with Ed Littlefield Jr.
events.blurb: Eunice's Savoy family, Ann, Marc, Joel and Wilson, play traditional Cajun music downtown with special guest Ed Littlefield Jr.
events.blurbEs: La familia Savoy de Eunice (Ann, Marc, Joel y Wilson) toca música cajún tradicional en el centro, con el invitado especial Ed Littlefield Jr.

events.title: Ragin' Cajuns Men's Basketball vs. McNeese
events.blurb: Louisiana hosts in-state rival McNeese in a non-conference game at the Cajundome.
events.blurbEs: Louisiana recibe a su rival estatal McNeese en un partido fuera de conferencia en el Cajundome.

events.title: Cajun French Music Jam
events.blurb: Musicians gather to play Cajun French tunes at Vermilionville, the Cajun and Creole living-history village on the bayou.
events.blurbEs: Músicos se reúnen para tocar canciones cajún en francés en Vermilionville, el pueblo de historia viva cajún y criolla junto al bayou.

events.title: Artists' Alliance
events.blurb: A group exhibition from AcA's Artists' Alliance fills the Main Gallery downtown. The building is closed Thanksgiving Day and Friday, so Saturday is the day to go.
events.blurbEs: Una exposición colectiva de Artists' Alliance del AcA llena la galería principal en el centro. El edificio cierra el Día de Acción de Gracias y el viernes, así que el sábado es el día para ir.

events.title: Lafayette Farmers & Artisans Market
events.blurb: The Saturday morning market at Moncus Park, with local farmers, food and artisans.
events.blurbEs: El mercado de los sábados por la mañana en Moncus Park, con agricultores, comida y artesanos locales.

events.title: Lake Martin
events.blurb: A cypress swamp with alligators and nesting egrets, 20 minutes from town.
events.blurbEs: Un pantano de cipreses con caimanes y garzas, a 20 minutos de la ciudad.
